prompts.label: Part A · 第 51 题
prompts.prompt: Write a notice to recruit a student for Prof. Smith’s research project on campus sports activities. Specify the duties and requirements of the job. Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in the notice; use “Li Ming” instead.

prompts.label: Part B · 第 52 题
prompts.prompt: Write an essay based on the picture below. In your essay, you should 1) describe the picture briefly, 2) interpret the implied meaning, and 3) give your comments. Write your answer in 160-200 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
